propositions: gerrit-verify.yaml and test.yml hand-copy identical gate+suite command sets, creating drift risk enforced by a fragile test-policing invariant instead of by construction
consolidate the duplicated lint/pip-audit/test job logic into a single parameterized reusable workflow (_build-and-test.yml) called by both test.yml and gerrit-verify.yaml
the reusable must support both branch-head (via actions/checkout) and Gerrit patchset (via checkout-gerrit-change-action) checkouts, parameterized by gerrit-refspec

rewrite test_ci_workflow_parity.py's five functions to validate the reusable as a single source and enforce delegation, not string-matching; preserve the three independent safety invariants (script asymmetry, pre-commit SKIP, redundant hooks)
gerrit-verify.yaml's currently-inline lint/mypy/config-check must be split out of the 4×matrix into the reusable's lint job to run once per change, reducing matrix multiplicity
test.yml retains its job-graph parallelism by keeping lint/pip-audit/test as separate delegated jobs; golden-path, external, and artifact-probe jobs remain in test.yml only
